collection_notes: Forest Grove Elections page (T1) lists the seats up Nov. 3, 2026: Mayor Malynda Wenzl, Councilor Mike Marshall, Councilor Karen Martinez and Council President Mariana Valenzuela; the Meet-the-Council page blocks automated fetch. Step 5 found only 2022-cycle Pamplin articles (not used, to keep treatment equal) and no 2026 coverage. Not among incumbents listed on the city's Elections page. Three pamphlet excerpts are truncated at ~110 characters by the fetch tool's quote limit. Gap-fill 2026-10-16: Campaign site issues/bio pages added (T2). Other Forest Grove candidates: Pereyda, Valenzuela, Knight have pamphlet items; Mejia and LePari have none, and the News-Times 2026 Q&A was not found, so source parity is uneven.
